title: Trie: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers
statement:
Given an array of N non-negative integers, find the maximum XOR value of any two elements in the array.

Use a Binary Trie (Prefix Tree on binary representation) to efficiently find, for each number, the number that produces the maximum XOR with it.

Print the maximum XOR value.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N non-negative integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum XOR of any two elements.
